why_company.draft:
Tekmetric's Director, Customer Success Operations role is compelling because it is explicitly a builder role.  The immediate expectation is not to inherit a finished operations team.  It is to do the analytical, enablement, process, and systems work directly, prove what works, and then build the organization around it.

That pattern is familiar to me.  My Customer Success and Support work has repeatedly combined hands-on operating ownership with process improvement.  At Dedrone, I standardized enterprise onboarding to about one month while engagement increased 25% and renewals increased 20%.  At Check Point, I helped move portfolio visibility from roughly 40% to 99% and built workflows across Salesforce, Custify, and Jira.  In Support leadership, enablement and automation contributed to lower ticket volume and faster first response.

I am particularly interested in Tekmetric's focus on the full onboarding motion from AE handoff through hypercare and CS graduation.  The metrics named in the role, including kickoff completion, time-to-live, graduation, CSAT, and early churn, create a clear operating contract for where the team should look for friction.

I would bring a hands-on, systems-oriented leadership style: Make the workflow visible, validate the data, remove manual failure points, build the enablement path, and use the operating evidence to decide what team and tooling should come next.

cover_letter.draft:
Dear Tekmetric Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Director, Customer Success Operations role because it combines the work I do best: Building the operating infrastructure around customer-facing teams while remaining close enough to the work to understand where the process actually breaks.

At Dedrone, I standardized enterprise onboarding to about one month while engagement increased 25% and renewals increased 20%.  At Check Point, I helped move portfolio visibility from roughly 40% to 99%, supported 99% dedicated CSM coverage for accounts above $50K, and built workflows across Salesforce, Custify, and Jira.  I have also led distributed customer-facing support teams and built enablement and automation that contributed to 30% ticket deflection, 40% fewer support tickets, and a 30-minute improvement in first response.

Tekmetric's specific operating model is particularly attractive to me.  The role owns the path from AE handoff through onboarding, go-live, hypercare, and CS graduation, while also building the analytics and enablement layer around a roughly 70-person organization.  I would approach that by defining the lifecycle and acceptance criteria first, making kickoff, rebook, time-to-live, graduation, CSAT, and early-churn metrics trustworthy, and then using those signals to prioritize process, tooling, capacity, and coaching improvements.

I also use AI-assisted automation to reduce repetitive operational work while keeping human validation over consequential metrics and decisions.  I built a synthetic candidate operating prototype for this role through Clintware to model the onboarding, analytics, enablement, handoff, and risk loops described in the public posting.

I would welcome the opportunity to build that operating discipline with Tekmetric.

Clinton Kosh
